title: Merge manager
description: The agent session that holds the merge-steward lane on one or more repositories and runs its watch loop (`merge-manager-watcher`, Process_MergeManagerWatch): it wakes on a timer, on PR events, when a main run finishes, or on a sibling's message; it reads the open PRs, the runner queue, main's verdict and the PR owners live; and it routes each reading to the merge train, a saturation meta-merge, or a stalled-agent takeover. One live session holds the lane per repository, and says so to the coordinator when it takes or hands over the lane. It merges only on the owner's explicit OK, holds and releases the swarm around every batch landing, and reports what landed and main's verdict.
